decisions.rationale: The initial person-directed relation is for, referring back to the murderer. De is expanded as such a person and is left unbanked as an anaphoric recast.
The second demonstrative recalls the actual stage and owns this. The noun stage is explanatory, not a lexical equivalent of de.
The complete occurrence noun is occurrence; direct prior full master evidence supports the nominal use. English of is nominal framing.
The negative existential denies occurrence and owns the first no. The repeated no actual commission later is explanatory and is not assigned again.
First victim is the one whose death completes the action. Exact whole GSAD BYA victim.
The first death predicate owns dies in the before-clause. Ma plus bar jointly create the temporal not-yet/until relation, recast as before; no isolated false negative null.
Complete negative predicate is exactly glossary cannot occur. Do not cut not out of cannot; no fifth affix exception is used.
The positive occurrence verb is a full separate English word strictly inside cannot occur, directly attested. The negative part cannot is left as the whole parent relation.
Second victim participates in the simultaneous-death comparison; this is distinct from the first before-clause victim.
The comparison relates murderer and victim at one time, rendered as after same time. Whole coordinator has a comparative local role; no additive and is invented.
Exact complete temporal adverb is glossary at the same time. Here it has one full explicit exponent; not a manufactured clause span.
Second death predicate has the murderer as its subject, distinct from first victim dies. The English names the understood subject; no missing source noun is invented.
The conditional case is recast as where in the second-place explanation. Select the unique case-introducing where; temporal wording is carried by mnyam du.
The new physical body in the rebirth explanation owns body here. Later the body is a pronoun expansion of des and is not a second lus occurrence.
The other body is another, locally explicit. Unrelated GZHAN auto-mined a bodhisattva is not treated as authority or changed.
Exact SKYES born. Supplied of the killer and has been remain outside.
The other person targeted by undertaking is the victim in this context. The whole lexical referent is supported by the preceding killer/victim case, not by equating isolated pha/rol/po to pieces.
Exact technical SBYOR BA undertaking. Stage of and this act are explanatory framing; source gsod pa killing is recast anaphorically as this act and is omitted rather than nulled.
Whole negative action predicate directly attests never went through. It does not own the nearby undertaking noun.
The negative is the complete separate word never inside its attested parent; no subword exception is required.
Direct BYAS PA glossary went through, a strictly tighter complete-word expression inside the negative parent.
The final causal relation explains absence of commission by the new body never undertaking the act. It owns this explicit because, not the separately supplied conclusion noun.
